residual_tests.scope: Finite FP16 patterns in selected operand combinations, not every possible triple.

conditioning_tests.scope: Finite half patterns in selected operand combinations, not every possible combination. Explicit round-to-nearest per operation.

limitations: Finite-input equivalence to existing student arithmetic, not native quality.
Complete student graph timings exclude D3D12 integration and do not accelerate native NVIDIA execution.
Exact full-image results cover only the checked checkpoints, inputs and environment.
Intervals average ten consecutive graph replays; p95 is an interval-average percentile, not per-frame tail latency.
Measured execution of experimental students plus grade, excluding D3D12 integration. No native-runtime acceleration.
One static input and one device; other desktop GPU work is not controlled.
No native-quality replacement is accepted or installed.
Width is the only requested model architecture change; the same data, seed and 4500 updates do not constitute matched FLOPs or establish seed-independent behavior.
The larger model has 995696 parameters versus 254672 in the smaller conditioned model. It does not improve every validation group or even the aggregate training error.
Only 46 training and 16 validation first-reset frames are used. Validation remains outside fitting but informs research choices; no representative temporal or game acceptance is established.

The new kernel fuses nearest indexing, skip add and feature conditioning, retaining each FP16 rounding. Tests cover selected finite operand patterns and current checkpoints, not every tensor value or environment.
Conditioning fusion is inference-only, optional and disabled by default. The unconditioned model is an unchanged negative timing control; its tiny timing difference is not a kernel improvement.
Full 1080p student-plus-grade graph timings exclude D3D12 integration. Alternating intervals average ten replays, not individual-frame tail latency.
No sample or game launch, no game/driver/native model or normal runtime changes.
